answer_2.quote: ...we evaluated raw-image Euclidean distance (L2) and the structural similarity index (SSIM)... we tested the popular LPIPS, its shift-tolerant variant ST-LPIPS, and an SSIM-inspired variant DISTS... DreamSim... we also evaluated our variant, DreamSim ℓ2, with Euclidean instead of cosine distance... we select DreamSim ℓ2 as the backbone for W1KP...

answer_4.quote: ...We crowd-sourced a dataset of two-alternative forced-choice (2AFC) image triplets using Amazon MTurk... Five unique workers were shown three generated images... instructed to pick whether A or B resembled the reference more... We collected a dataset of graded image pairs with MTurk... workers were presented with two images generated from the same prompt and asked to judge the similarity on an integral scale ranging from 'not similar at all' (rating 1) to 'the same' (5)...
answer_4.guideline: Workers were asked to select the image most similar to a reference (2AFC) and to rate similarity between image pairs on a 1‑5 scale (later collapsed to four categories: high, medium, low, none).
